node.title: L1 core bipolar signed-quotient normal form
node.statement: For a core partitioned into complete P-fibers, orient each exact defect fiber as dense or sparse, with ties sparse. The defect locator has a unique signed quotient presentation F_D L_H=L_S product_(a in A_+)(P-a), where H is the set of holes in dense fibers, S is the occupied set in sparse fibers, gcd(L_H,L_S)=1, and deg L_H+deg L_S equals the symmetric core polarity. The triple (A_+,H,S) reconstructs D exactly. This identifies growing core polarity with growing signed mark degree but supplies no periodic owner or count.
